name: not-applicable-where-not-permitted
why: Question 1.1 marked Not Applicable, which its template forbids. The number that comes out is 100%, and that is exactly the problem the na_allowed flag exists to prevent — every Not Applicable narrows the denominator, so permitting it freely lets a site certify by declaring questions inapplicable. The engine honours what was recorded, so the figure on screen matches the data, and reports the violation. The submission is refused on is_valid, not on the percentage.
